scope: Bounded public-source CPU, Swift compiler and headless Metal correctness checks; generated images only. No game, app, headset, USB/HID, encoder, installation or user setting changes.
commands: swiftc -typecheck -swift-version 6 -target arm64-apple-macos14.0 app/Sources/Halliday/*.swift (with repository module/framework search paths)
execution_note: The two GPU suites were compiled with the checked-in scripts; their exact resulting executables were invoked with repository resource and result paths. Sandbox GPU visibility required an explicitly authorized headless Metal execution. No app was launched.

swift6_full_typecheck.diagnostics: One pre-existing unused view binding warning in AppDelegate.updateDock; no errors.

limits: Image-only extrapolation, not AMD FSR Frame Generation or depth/motion-vector ASW.
This public source was not physically retested in a headset; retained local acceptance of an earlier development build is not a new public-build comfort measurement.
No game FPS, optical latency, sustained physical presentation smoothness or universal detection of all scene cuts is inferred.
The source-wiring assertions cover Renderer/presenter classification; the headless GPU suites execute GameSpacewarp and authentic AMD directly, not the entire physical presentation chain.
